framework: CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1 — Implementation Group 1

families.name: Data Protection & Privacy
families.riskDescription: Weaknesses in data handling could expose sensitive information to unauthorized access, loss, or improper disposal.

safeguards.title: Establish and Maintain a Data Management Process
Establish and Maintain a Data Inventory
Configure Data Access Control Lists
Enforce Data Retention
Securely Dispose of Data
Encrypt Data on End-User Devices

families.name: Access & Identity Management
families.citation: CIS Controls 5 & 6 — Account Management, Access Control Management
families.riskDescription: Gaps in account and access management increase the risk of unauthorized system or data access.

safeguards.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
Use Unique Passwords
Disable Dormant Accounts
Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts
Establish an Access Granting Process
Establish an Access Revoking Process
Require MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Require MFA for Administrative Access

families.name: Vulnerability & Threat Management
families.citation: CIS Controls 7 & 10 — Continuous Vulnerability Management, Malware Defenses
families.riskDescription: Unpatched systems or inadequate malware defenses increase exposure to known exploits and malicious software.

safeguards.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
Establish and Maintain a Remediation Process
Perform Automated Operating System Patch Management
Perform Automated Application Patch Management
Deploy and Maintain Anti-Malware Software
Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Signature Updates
Disable Autorun and Autoplay for Removable Media

families.name: Asset Inventory & Data Recovery
families.citation: CIS Controls 1 & 11 — Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets, Data Recovery
families.riskDescription: Unmanaged assets can go unnoticed, and weak data recovery can prevent restoring systems to a trusted state after an incident.

safeguards.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Address Unauthorized Assets
Establish and Maintain a Data Recovery Process
Perform Automated Backups
Protect Recovery Data
Establish and Maintain an Isolated Instance of Recovery Data

families.name: Vendor & Service Provider Oversight
families.riskDescription: Without a maintained inventory of service providers, this vendor's own third-party risk may go unmanaged.

safeguards.title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Providers

families.name: Security Awareness & Incident Response
families.citation: CIS Controls 14 & 17 — Security Awareness and Skills Training, Incident Response Management
families.riskDescription: Insufficient security training or incident response readiness can slow detection and containment of a security incident.

safeguards.title: Establish and Maintain a Security Awareness Program
Train Workforce Members to Recognize Social Engineering Attacks
Train Workforce Members on Authentication Best Practices
Train Workforce on Data Handling Best Practices
Train Workforce Members on Causes of Unintentional Data Exposure
Train Workforce Members on Recognizing and Reporting Security Incidents
Train Workforce on How to Identify and Report if Their Enterprise Assets are Missing Security Updates
Train Workforce on the Dangers of Connecting to and Transmitting Enterprise Data Over Insecure Networks
Designate Personnel to Manage Incident Handling
Establish and Maintain Contact Information for Reporting Security Incidents
Establish and Maintain an Enterprise Process for Reporting Incidents
